description: Reverse-ETL sink: create-or-update an upstream DataFrame into Help Scout conversations. A row with a conversation_id present updates the existing conversation (tags/note/status); otherwise a new conversation is created, which natively auto-upserts the underlying Customer by email.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Help Scout conversation (created, or updated if conversation_id_column has a value).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / rows_skipped_no_key / rows_skipped_noop). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Help Scout.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

mailbox_id.label: Mailbox Id
mailbox_id.description: Target Help Scout mailbox ID for new conversations.

conversation_id_column.label: Conversation Id Column
conversation_id_column.description: Upstream column holding an existing conversation ID. Present -> UPDATE; absent -> CREATE.

customer_email_column.label: Customer Email Column
customer_email_column.description: Upstream column holding the customer's email. CREATE identifier -- Help Scout auto-upserts the Customer by this email.

customer_first_name_column.label: Customer First Name Column
customer_first_name_column.description: Upstream column holding the customer's first name. CREATE only.

customer_last_name_column.label: Customer Last Name Column
customer_last_name_column.description: Upstream column holding the customer's last name. CREATE only.

subject_column.label: Subject Column
subject_column.description: Upstream column holding the conversation subject. Required for CREATE.

body_column.label: Body Column
body_column.description: Upstream column holding the initial thread text. Required for CREATE.

tags_column.label: Tags Column
tags_column.description: Upstream column holding tags (comma-separated string or list). CREATE: included in create body. UPDATE: FULL REPLACE via update_tags, not additive.

note_column.label: Note Column
note_column.description: Upstream column holding note text. UPDATE only: posts via add_note.

status_column.label: Status Column
status_column.description: Upstream column holding a status value. UPDATE only: calls patch_status.

conversation_type.label: Conversation Type
conversation_type.description: Help Scout conversation type for new conversations.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Overall safety cap on rows per run.

name: Help Scout Conversation Upsert
